name: sa-analysis
description: Checks over a written architecture: ten risk and design-characteristics analyses (SPOF, Blast Radius, Bottleneck, Cost Hotspots, STRIDE, Vendor Lock-in, Latency Budget, Tech Debt/EOL, Coupling, Data Sensitivity) plus the consolidated Security Posture, and the PO Spec coverage report (TRACEABILITY_REPORT.md). Reads the architecture through sa-skills, which installs it as a dependency.
